name: nginx-production
description: Nginx reverse-proxy conventions for publishing local Docker services safely.
guidelines: Proxy to loopback-published application ports by default.
Forward Host, real client IP, X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto headers.
Include WebSocket upgrade headers when realtime transports may be used.
Run nginx -t before reload; rollback an invalid candidate configuration.
Do not overwrite or remove Nginx sites not marked as term_5-managed.
